resources.string: Turn on Continuum in your keyboard settings, then switch to it.
Almost done: switch to Continuum as your keyboard.
← delete word · → space · ↓ numbers · ↑ full · ↖ ↗ enter
How to type, gestures, emoji, clipboard, privacy
Put every setting back as it was. Learned words and your KLIPY key are kept.
Theme, layout, sizes, typing and gesture settings go back to their defaults.
Extra space between the keys and Android\'s navigation bar or gesture handle. The keys never overlap it.
Removes Android\'s keyboard-switch and hide-keyboard buttons from under the keys (Android 16+), giving the space back. Hold shift, or the space bar in the full keyboard, to switch keyboards.
Full keyboard only. Off: words are typed exactly and learned. Also the switch in the suggestion bar.
How long to hold before a popup opens
Clear the words and phrases learned from your typing
Suggestions go back to the built-in dictionary. This can\'t be undone.

Every touch that moves is either a tap or a swipe (delete word, space, enter, numbers, full keyboard; see the Guide). A stroke is a swipe only if it\'s at least the shortest swipe, straight enough, and either fast enough or as long as a long swipe. Otherwise it counts as a tap where your finger first landed.
The minimum distance for a swipe. Anything shorter is always a tap, however fast. Raise it if quick taps turn into swipes; lower it for shorter swipes.
How fast a short swipe must be. Lower: gentle flicks count as swipes. Higher: only quick flicks do, so slow sliding stays a tap.
Strokes at least this long are swipes even when slow. Lower it if slow swipes are ignored; raise it if slow drags to a letter become swipes.
How straight the path must be: the distance from start to end, as a share of the path\'s length. Higher: curved or wobbly strokes are taps. Lower: they still count as swipes.
Add a free KLIPY key to search GIFs
The GIF and clipboard tabs in the emoji panel. Turn off if you don\'t use GIFs or have no KLIPY key. The clipboard then opens only from mini mode\'s symbol row.
Not set. Get a free key at partner.klipy.com
Only GIF searches and the GIFs you pick are sent to KLIPY, with an anonymous ID. Nothing you type in apps is sent.
Type ##e to insert text you save here

Type ## and then a letter or digit to insert its text, e.g. ##e for your email. Backspace right after puts back what you typed. Upper and lower case are the same shortcut. Not used in password fields.

Mini mode puts every letter in one row. Tap near the letters you mean and Continuum works out the word from where you tapped, how common words are and what you usually type. The middle of the suggestion bar shows its best guess.
Space types the middle suggestion. A second space right after a word types a full stop, and the bar then offers other punctuation to swap it for.
Hold on the letter row to zoom in. Slide sideways to pick one letter exactly, or slide up to the symbol row. Lift to type it.
Tap shift for one capital, tap it twice quickly for caps lock. Auto-capitalisation (Typing) capitalises the start of each sentence.

Hold shift (it shows ⋯) and slide onto the sliders icon to open these settings, or onto the keyboard icon to switch to another keyboard. In the full keyboard, holding the space bar also switches keyboards.
Tap a word to use it. Drag the bar sideways for more. Hold a word to remove it from suggestions for good. When a word has an emoji, it appears right after the word; tapping it replaces the word.
Backspace right after a word reopens it, so you can pick a different suggestion. After you delete a whole word, the bar offers it again with its alternatives.

Mini mode always picks the most likely word. In the full keyboard, autocorrect (the switch at the left of the bar, or Typing → Autocorrect) fixes typos like \"teh\"; with it off, letters are typed exactly as tapped.
Swipe left anywhere to delete the last word (punctuation after it goes first), right to type a space.
Swipe up in mini mode for the full keyboard. Swipe down to switch between letters and numbers; in the full keyboard, swipe down from the suggestion bar to go back to mini mode.
Up-left or up-right acts as enter. If swipes are mistaken for taps or the other way round, adjust Gestures → Sensitivity.
A normal keyboard in the same style. The small character on each key is typed by holding it. Hold the full stop for , ! ?
123 opens two pages of numbers and symbols. In mini mode, swipe down for the number row; hold on it to zoom in, like the letters.
Password and number fields always open the full keyboard, type exactly what you tap, and never learn from what you type.
In mini mode, hold the row, slide up and onto ☺. In the full keyboard, hold the comma. Tabs at the top jump between groups; your most used emoji come first.

In mini mode, hold the row, slide up and onto the clipboard at the far left. It\'s also a tab in the emoji panel, unless Show GIFs (Settings → GIFs) is off. Tap a clip to paste it, hold to delete it, or tap the bin to clear all. Continuum keeps up to 30 clips for 7 days and skips anything copied from password or private fields.

In the emoji panel, tap GIF. Tap the search field to type, enter to search, then tap a GIF to send it. Apps that don\'t take GIFs get the link instead. Needs a free KLIPY key (Settings → GIFs), where you can also hide the GIF tab.

Continuum learns the words you type, how you spell them, and which words follow which. A new word typed once shows up next to the best guess; type it again or pick it from the bar and it becomes a normal suggestion. Typing → Forget learned words clears everything learned.
Everything you type stays on your phone and is never backed up to the cloud. Private (incognito) fields teach it nothing. The only thing that goes online is a GIF search, sent to KLIPY.
Theme: Chameleon (the default) gives each app\'s keyboard that app\'s own colour, with no two apps alike; or pick a fixed theme. Layout: QWERTZ or QWERTY.
Height sliders for the mini keyboard, the full keyboard and the suggestion bar, and the space under the keys. The keys always sit above Android\'s navigation bar or gesture handle.
On the main settings page. Puts every setting back to its default; your learned words and KLIPY key stay.

Continuum is an independent continuation of Minuum, not affiliated with Whirlscape. Word frequencies: hermitdave/FrequencyWords, from OpenSubtitles (CC BY-SA 4.0). Common misspellings: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0). Emoji list and emoji suggestions: Unicode, Inc. and Unicode CLDR (Unicode License V3).
